groups.contract: Optional gable candidate search proves face indexing and rejects obstructed set-outs before mutation
groups.disposition: The full386-line body was personally read. Caller checks enclosure polygon len>=3 before Candidate::find reads polygon[0]. Eligible roles are TownHouse/FachwerkMerchantHouse, parentless Gable roofs and TimberInfill faces. Tie/head predicates establish horizontal span and minimum1m clearance plus.10 sill before candidate construction. Fixed cardinal normal rounding, positive nonzero tie direction and actual roof extent remain owning geometry assumptions. Candidate steps=floor(half_span/.025) use actual supported roof size; no arbitrary huge-roof work allegation. Candidate fits checks head extent, obstruction and residual polygon area before any new opening publication. Boolean polygon difference is intentional geometric subtraction, unrelated to supplied CROSS-LENS006 overlapping-water XOR cause.

groups.contract: Gable mutation keeps exact measured bearings and temporary counter ownership within the consuming build
groups.disposition: Candidate fields feed the fallible RectangularRoofWindow builder, checked glazing resize and measured intersection bounds. Original member IDs are preserved; optional members use a separate range and saved builder counters are restored on success. A builder.member failure returns before counter restoration, so this private helper is not independently retry-transactional; the actual consuming plan failure path discards the builder. No successful retry on that partially changed builder was shown. ID stride16/roof ID arithmetic and max-bay+1 require actual bounded roof graph identity, not mere integer wrapper closure. SpatialBounds rejects empty/reversed bearing intersection rather than publishing invalid contact. All mutation errors remain source-qualified until their actual owning publication boundary.

groups.contract: Obstacle lookup requires one-to-one spatial-index provenance and actual physical member identity
groups.disposition: All119lines, including its fixture, were read. The member list and bounds list are constructed in the same order; BoundsIndex errors propagate. Actual overlapping() index production remains the geometry_index owner dependency, not independently proven by the raw usize consumer. Missing referenced solids are filtered and duplicate solid IDs choose first; accepted graph identity is therefore a precondition, not a new aggregate validator. Intersections exempt only the exact tie/head IDs and use the physical solid-overlap kernel. The test oracle compares bounded indexed/exhaustive contacts for sloped members, but it was not executed.
